Anya (Design): Dropping the next iteration of the Create API Key modal in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Main items to confirm: default expiry, prominence of 'Never', where the role scope checklist sits, and the exact wording for the long-lived key warning. Trying to make this a tiny ship tomorrow.

Sam C (Product): My take: default to 90 days. Keep 'Never' but visually secondary (lighter, lower emphasis). If someone picks Admin scope + Never we should surface a mandatory confirmation checkbox. Also prefer concise warning text.

Kevin (Eng): Engineering constraints: no DB schema change needed for default. Secret reveal should be ephemeral: only fetch secret after explicit click and never render it server-side in HTML. Copy-to-clipboard should show a short tooltip "Copied" and we should fire a telemetry event when a key is created and when 'Never' is chosen.

Liz (Accessibility): Accessibility checklist: 1) The reveal button needs dynamic aria-labels: "Reveal API key" / "Hide API key". 2) Use aria-live="polite" for copy confirmations. 3) Link expiry warning via aria-describedby to the expiry control. 4) Ensure logical tab order: role scopes first, expiry next.

Anya (Design): Draft copy options: - Expiry label: "Key expiry (recommended)"; default option text: "90 days" - Warning when Never selected: "This key will not expire. Long-lived keys increase exposure if leaked 12 rotate regularly and limit scopes." (trying to stay short)

Sam C (Product): Slight edit: "This key will not expire. Long-lived keys increase exposure if leaked 12 rotate regularly and limit scopes." And add the Admin+Never checkbox text: "I acknowledge this key will never expire and may increase risk."

Kevin (Eng): Can implement the checkbox. Implementation notes for the reveal: prefer using a button like `<button class=\"reveal\" aria-label=\"Reveal API key\" data-state=\"hidden\">Show</button>`; on click fetch ephemeral secret, set data-state to 'visible', set innerText for display element (not value attr), and set focus to that element so screen readers announce it.

Liz (Accessibility): Minor correction: `aria-pressed` isn't ideal for a transient reveal. Keep explicit changing `aria-label` and use `aria-expanded` only if there's an associated region. Use aria-describedby to connect the warning and the confirmation checkbox. Checkbox label must be programmatic and focusable.

Anya (Design): I'll: make 'Never' less prominent, default 90d, move role checklist above expiry, add Admin+Never confirmation checkbox, and shorten warning. Will upload an updated screenshot tomorrow morning. Liz, can you do a keyboard/screen-reader smoke test when I post? :thumbsup:

Liz (Accessibility): Yep, will run a quick pass after you update. Please include keyboard flow notes in the screenshot (tab order numbers).

Kevin (Eng): One more dev nit: the copy-to-clipboard tooltip should optionally append expiry info when available, e.g. "Copied 12 expires in 90 days". If Never, just "Copied" + hidden sr-only text "This key does not expire." Also ensure we don't keep secrets in memory longer than needed.

Anya (Design): Good call. For the tooltip text: include expiry when not Never. Keep visible tooltip minimal and put extra context in sr-only.

deploy-bot: Archived thread 1819999999-bulk-revoke-block-mixed-types for reference.

Anya (Design): Quick question: do we want the expiry selector to show absolute date somewhere (e.g., "Expires: 2026-06-30") after selection or just relative?

Sam C (Product): Show both: relative by default (90 days) and on reveal/copy show the absolute date in screen-reader text.

Kevin (Eng): We'll compute absolute expiry on the client from the selected option and include it in sr-only and in telemetry.

Anya (Design): Perfect. I'll iterate and post updated files. Thanks! :sparkles:
